spans.s:
ह्यस् ह्यस्, ind. (perhaps fr. 5. ह + द्यस्),
yesterday; [cf. Gr. χθές, ἐ-χθές, χθιζό-ς,
χθεσ-ινό-ς; Lat. heri, hes-ternu-s; Goth. gistra-dagis;
Old Germ. gester, ‘yesterday.’]
—ह्यो-भव, अस्,
आ, अम्, what happened yesterday.

ह्यस्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, hesternal, belonging to
yesterday, produced or occurred yesterday.
—ह्यस्-
तन-दिन, अम्, n. the day just past, yesterday.
ह्यस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hesternal, of yesterday.
